image_description: An interior view of a rustic, traditional sawmill or lumber processing facility. The scene features a large, raw log positioned on a heavy-duty wooden track system (carriage) in the foreground. In the background, there are stacks of processed yellow lumber planks. The structure consists of rough-hewn wooden beams and posts supporting a corrugated metal roof and walls. Sunlight streams in from the left, illuminating dust particles in the air.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The individual planks in the background stacks lack distinct separation lines in some areas, appearing slightly fused or 'mushy' rather than sharp, discrete boards. This is a common AI artifact in repetitive geometric patterns.

The mechanical components of the log carriage (the metal/wood assembly holding the log) are structurally ambiguous. It is unclear how the clamps attach to the base, and some elements seem to float or merge without clear physical joints.
The vertical support beams on the far left show slight warping and inconsistent width, deviating from the straight lines expected in rigid construction.

To verify the spatial relationship between the foreground log carriage and the background lumber stacks, ensuring they don't bleed into each other.
To check if the individual planks in the background stacks have clean, separate boundaries or if they suffer from fusion artifacts.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the wood grain and metal surfaces.

Separation and definition of individual planks in background lumber stacks
